scope: ordinary positive-price NPC service2 purchases only

provenance.mode0_cash_and_mode1_bound_silver: client_verified original radio controls and purchase dispatch
provenance.ordinary_price: client_verified original citemattr.price; require positive integer and actual original shelf membership
provenance.mode1_price_and_binding: designed same unit price, bound-silver-only expense and binding1 output; original complete server recipe unknown

0.receipt: preserve existing mode0 fingerprint and policy recipe byte-for-byte

1.receipt: include payment mode, currency, binding and this payment policy in the new mode1 intent

eligibility: current trusted service2 ticket, exact full NPC instance and current map/location/generation/role lease; currently authorized ordinary shop and original stocked item; stock row alone is not original service authorization
cost: original positive unit price multiplied by exact integer quantity; insufficient funds or overflow rejects the whole caller transaction
output: actual inventory-owned instance factory; merge only compatible item and binding metadata; never merge mode1 goods into unbound goods
transaction: one existing role-owner caller transaction covers wallet, bag, resource source synchronization, NPC/domain/common receipts and required reply encoding; module opens no independent connection or commit
replay: same accepted command and identical intent applies once; conflicting reuse rejects; paid reply reads current wallet and inventory, never historical receipt balances
wire_identity: original purchase packet has no request ID; distinct newly admitted identical packets are distinct purchases, while retrying an existing accepted command retains its stable internal ID
late_failure: wallet, bag, source and all receipts roll back together; retry of the failed stable ID may succeed once
sellback: existing binding-aware sale rules remain authoritative; bound purchase does not grant a new cash sellback or unbinding path
compatibility: currency.1 adds only npc_shop_bound purpose; retain existing wallet balances, mode0 receipt fingerprints and paid records; no global npc policy bump or migration
activation: wallet purpose only; NPC domain implementation, shared integration, fixed deployment and GUI each require their own evidence
